input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position in full. 13.1 extends the subscription grant to Customer's Affiliates and to contractors acting on their behalf (and to Authorized Users), with no "non-transferable" or "revocable" qualifier. 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to delivered/embedded Vendor Technology, including modification and contractor support, and 14.3 confirms that licence reaches Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable. 13.3 bars any revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity — so there is no at-will revocation — and expressly permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in an assignment permitted by Section 24, which allows Customer to assign to an M&A successor without consent. 13.4's use restrictions are narrow (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass, unlawful use) and expressly do not limit authorized security testing or use of Customer Data and output, so they do not undercut the permitted use. No redline required.
